title: Our Facility
description: Learn more about place where you can change your life! Strength, golf simulator, reformer pilates and recovery at Studio 22, Dun Laoghaire.

sections.label: Strength
sections.headline: Training that actually works

paragraphs: Every session is structured to help you improve week after week.
